articles.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia leaves U.S. voluntarily for Spain
articles.summary: Abrego Garcia, a Salvadoran immigrant who became a symbol of Trump's mass deportation campaign, voluntarily left the country on Tuesday  after nearly two years of  legal battles.

articles.title: Fugitive murderer who hid in UK for 27 years as fake refugee is allowed to stay in Britain after Albania dropped extradition bid because 'too much time has passed'
articles.summary: Sabri Sopoti, 60, shot a man dead with a Scorpion submachine gun at a cafe in northern Albania in December 1999 before fleeing the country.

articles.title: Today in Germany: A roundup of the latest news on Wednesday
articles.summary: Left Party group in Berlin votes to oust Vanessa Emde for statements on Israel, World War II bomb in Nuremberg to be defused, police union calls for better resources to protect women from domestic violence and more news on Wednesday, November 25th.

articles.title: Hamas says key security chief killed in strike
articles.summary: Hamas claims Muhammad Majed Abu al-Ouf and family killed in Israeli airstrike in western Gaza City.
